race.title: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: MADE IN REUGNY was a big-money purchase after finishing second in a newcomers race at Compiegne last autumn and has been found an excellent opportunity to go one better on his UK/stable debut. Goodbye Earl and Campfield Flyer could be the pair to fill the places. MADE IN REUGNY (FR) GOODBYE EARL (IRE) CAMPFIELD FLYER
